summary.en: The eruption affected communities around Sumbawa. Food shortages also caused deaths.
summary.zh: 喷发波及松巴哇周边居民，灾后缺粮也造成人员死亡。

detail.en: GVP volcano 264040 locates Tambora. Eruption record 16231 covers 1812–1815 and has VEI 7. VEI measures volcanic explosiveness, not earthquake size. NCEI event 613 gives the 10 April disaster date within this longer episode.
detail.zh: GVP 火山 264040 标出坦博拉。喷发记录 16231 跨越 1812—1815 年，VEI 为 7。VEI 描述火山爆发程度，与地震震级不同。NCEI 事件 613 给出这段活动中的 4 月 10 日灾害日期。

scope.en: Surrounding areas; historical estimate reported by USGS HVO.
scope.zh: 周边地区；USGS 夏威夷火山观测站记载的历史估计。

scope.en: A separate historical estimate, with starvation as the main cause. The two estimates are not limits of one calculation.
scope.zh: 另一项历史估计，主要死因为饥饿。两项估计不是同一次计算的上下限。

summary.en: The disaster caused about 36,000 deaths, mainly from tsunamis, according to a USGS historical table.
summary.zh: USGS 历史表记载，灾害造成约 36,000 人死亡，主要由于海啸。

detail.en: The undated USGS table lists 36,417 deaths, mainly from tsunamis; it was read on 27 October 2026. The modern volcano point locates Krakatau without reconstructing its 1883 coast. The eruption episode began before the major disaster day.
detail.zh: 未注明发布日期的 USGS 表列出 36,417 人死亡，主要由于海啸；读取日为 2026 年 10 月 27 日。现代火山点用来定位，没有复原 1883 年海岸。整段喷发活动早于主要灾害日开始。

scope.en: Mainly from tsunamis; rounded historical estimate in the USGS table.
scope.zh: 主要由于海啸；USGS 表中取整的历史估计。

summary.en: NOAA/ITIC’s October 2024 accounting records 227,899 people dead or missing and presumed dead in 15 countries.
summary.zh: NOAA/ITIC 2024 年 10 月统计记载，15 个国家共 227,899 人死亡或失踪并推定死亡。

detail.en: USGS gives Mw 9.1, depth 30 km and origin time 2004-12-26 00:58:53.450 UTC. MSS gives magnitude 9.2. The epicentre lies above the rupture’s start; the underground break extends farther. The USGS tsunami flag is 0, but NCEI event 2439 documents the tsunami.
detail.zh: USGS 给出 Mw 9.1、深度 30 公里，发震时刻为 UTC 2004-12-26 00:58:53.450。MSS 给出震级 9.2。震中在地下破裂起点上方，破裂还延伸到更远。USGS 海啸标记为 0，但 NCEI 事件 2439 记录了海啸。

label.en: Dead or missing and presumed dead
label.zh: 死亡或失踪并推定死亡

scope.en: 15 countries, NOAA/ITIC October 2024 accounting. Earthquake and tsunami deaths cannot be fully separated. Four countries shown; not a complete breakdown.
scope.zh: 15 个国家，NOAA/ITIC 2024 年 10 月统计；无法完全拆分地震与海啸死亡。这里只列四个国家，并非完整分项。

title.zh: 喀拉喀托之子（Anak Krakatau）崩塌，2018 年

summary.en: Volcanic collapse triggered a tsunami in the Sunda Strait. These observations belong to 2018, a separate event from 1883.
summary.zh: 火山体崩塌引发巽他海峡海啸。这组观测属于 2018 年，与 1883 年是两次事件。

detail.en: The point locates GVP’s Krakatau reference centre, rather than the measured start of collapse. GVP’s 2018–2020 eruption episode began on 18 June 2018. NCEI event 5699 gives the later tsunami’s date.
detail.zh: 点标出 GVP 喀拉喀托参考中心，并非实测崩塌起点。GVP 的 2018—2020 年喷发活动始于 2018 年 6 月 18 日。NCEI 事件 5699 给出后来海啸的日期。

title.zh: 西苏门答腊地震，2022 年

summary.en: People in Singapore felt this distant earthquake. Their reports describe local shaking; catalogue values describe the source.
summary.zh: 新加坡有人感到这次远处地震。本地报告描述震感，目录数值描述震源。

detail.en: USGS record us6000gzyg gives magnitude 6.1, type mww, and depth 4 km. EOS’s public-lecture page gives 6.2. These estimate earthquake size, not shaking intensity in Singapore. The chapter links BCA’s guidance and gives the date it was read.
detail.zh: USGS 记录 us6000gzyg 给出震级 6.1、类型 mww、深度 4 公里。EOS 公开讲座页面给出 6.2。这些数值估计地震规模，并非新加坡烈度。章节附有建设局指引及读取日期。

summary.en: Tambora’s location in the GVP catalogue. A location point does not mean an eruption on the date shown.
summary.zh: GVP 目录中的坦博拉位置。地点标记不表示所示日期正在喷发。

detail.en: This marker stays in place as the timeline changes. Its date does not mark a founding or an eruption.
detail.zh: 年代改变时，这个地点标记仍留在原位。标记日期不表示地点建立或发生喷发。

summary.en: Krakatau’s modern GVP reference centre. The coast shows modern geography.
summary.zh: GVP 的喀拉喀托现代参考中心，海岸也采用现代地图。

detail.en: This marker stays in place as the timeline changes. Its date does not mark a founding or an eruption.
detail.zh: 年代改变时，这个地点标记仍留在原位。标记日期不表示地点建立或发生喷发。

summary.en: A volcano inside an oceanic plate. Volcanoes also occur away from boundaries.
summary.zh: 大洋板块内部的火山。火山也会出现在边界以外。

detail.en: This marker stays in place as the timeline changes. Its date does not mark a founding or an eruption.
detail.zh: 年代改变时，这个地点标记仍留在原位。标记日期不表示地点建立或发生喷发。

summary.en: A point to help locate Singapore. It is not an instrument station or a shaking measurement for any building.
summary.zh: 用来找到新加坡的方位点，不是仪器站，也不表示某幢楼的摇晃测量。

detail.en: This marker stays in place as the timeline changes. Its date does not mark a founding or an eruption.
detail.zh: 年代改变时，这个地点标记仍留在原位。标记日期不表示地点建立或发生喷发。
